thread:
incident-bot: PAGER TRIGGERED • service=inference-runtime • severity=P2 • alert=log-rate-error-spike • 1.2k errors in 5m (↑x12) • paging oncall @alice • https://ops.redwood/internal/incidents/1765432100

alice: acked, investigating — pulling logs and traces now.

bob: i'm looking at the ingress charts. QPS steady, error mass on a few hosts in us-west-2.

ciara: can you paste a sample error? trying to see if this is kv-evict noise.

alice: sample from pod inference-rt-3: 
```
2026-05-11T15:21:34Z ERROR handler.go:213 failed to write cache entry: kv store timeout: context deadline exceeded
stack: ...
```

alice: also seeing a lot of `503 healthcheck` entries in the same 5m window — looks synthetic.

dinesh: the alert query currently matches any `status >= 500`. if healthcheck requests are tagged origin="healthcheck" they're inflating counts.

eve: recommend quick suppress while we fix the query. 20m mute and then re-evaluate?

alice: creating a 20m suppression now.

deploy-bot: Suppression created by alice — alert=log-rate-error-spike • duration=20m • reason="investigating healthcheck noise" • id=sup-1765432100

bob: while suppressed, two changes to land: (1) update the log alert to filter out healthcheck origin, (2) add a regex signature to de-escalate known kv timeout messages.

ciara: drafting query change. current (simplified):
```
count_over_time({service=\"inference-runtime\"} |= \"ERROR\" | status >= 500[5m])
```
proposed tweak:
```
count_over_time({service=\"inference-runtime\"} |= \"ERROR\" and !~\"origin=\\\"healthcheck\\\"\" | status >= 500[5m])
```
plus a lower-severity signature for `kv store timeout`.

dinesh: regex for signature suggestion: `kv store timeout|context deadline exceeded|connection reset by peer` — will add to the log-rules signatures list. keep it permissive but not too broad.

alice: applying change in staging and will open PR to alert-config.

alice: PR: https://github.com/redwood/alert-config/pull/462 — query exclusion + signature. tagging @monitoring-bot for CI run.

monitoring-bot: CI passed (lint + sim). preparing rollout of alert-config change to prod in ~2m.

bob: spinning up a quick incident dashboard to track per-host error slices and healthcheck-filtered views.

bob: dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/d/inf-errors/inference-error-slice — panels: per-host 5xx rate, proto breakdown, healthcheck-excluded series.

ciara: live mitigation: adding an automatic fallback rule to route traffic off hosts with >50% 5xx in last 1m. deploying now.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: alert-config v2.13 -> prod (changes: exclude healthcheck origin; add suppression signature).

alice: suppression expired (20m). alert re-evaluated after rule update — no new pages so far.

dinesh: verified post-rollout: healthcheck-origin 503s no longer counted. signature matched ~180 events flagged as transient kv timeouts, not escalations.

eve: customer-impact check: support flagged elevated latency for 2 customers earlier (acme-corp, streamly). traced to affected hosts, no data loss. opening outreach ticket.

alice: created ticket INF-3219 — affected: acme-corp, streamly — outreach owner: eve — priority P3.

ciara: post-incident action items added:
- make `origin` parsing mandatory in log ingestion pipeline
- change alert to use percentile baseline (p95/p99) instead of absolute thresholds
- add unit tests for signature matching in alert-config

bob: i'll keep the dashboard pinned for 24h and add a host-fallback alert to trigger an ops page if routing hasn't remediated.

alice: handing off to next oncall @dinesh for follow-up and postmortem. summary posted to incident page. thanks all :thumbsup:

dinesh: taking over. scheduling a short blameless postmortem tomorrow 11:00 PST. will include rule diff, dashboard snapshots, and matching log samples.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED • incident_id=1765432100 • status=mitigated • lead=alice • followup_ticket=INF-3219
